changedContracts: Browser profile timestamps require complete canonical RFC3339 syntax and Gregorian calendar/clock/offset bounds; Date.parse normalization is removed.
Optional null and omitted timestamps remain distinct in browser objects and retain existing Go zero-time semantics; valid offset and fractional text is unchanged.
A shared65case table exercises both Go profile Decode/roundtrip and browser validateProfile/raw JSON/editor/offline preservation; all cases seed profile fuzzing.
Real-browser cases2and4 now reject invalid calendar imports/edits and verify all65cases, null transfer and exact nanosecond/offset preservation.
Fixed browser and native numeric reports bind the shared fixture; native reports also bind its Go consumer.
limits: Finite65case conformance and thirty-second native mutation do not establish exhaustive input coverage or long-duration stability.
Native Go execution is Windows/Linux AMD64/ARM64; macOS/BSD are compile-only in this checkpoint.
Conformance checks canonical JSON value encodings; they do not prove every alternate raw JSON timestamp spelling or every SDK encoding behavior.
Browser acceptance uses source-built Linux fixtures with unchanged52cases,256profiles and25performance caps, not signed installed or managed endpoints or native assistive technology.
The pure Node suites explicitly skip four actual-Go wire-fixture cases; native Go root and real-browser tests are separate evidence.
Signing identity, held Mac launch-preparation diagnostics, private-output architecture selection and all broader fifty-gate enterprise desktop requirements remain open.
